title: Persist verified provider connection status
context: ProvidersScreen always reports a configured remote provider as Not tested, even after Settings successfully tests it. The test result is held only in transient view state and is lost when the Settings screen closes.
goal: Persist only the non-secret result and provider identity of the last connection test, display it in ProvidersScreen, and invalidate it when provider configuration changes.
forbidden_changes: Never persist API keys, Authorization headers, or response bodies.
Do not treat a connection test as proof that chat completion or model inference works.
Do not change provider request endpoints or credential storage semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Successful/failed connection tests persist only provider ID and a result enum in UserDefaults.
ProvidersScreen distinguishes not tested, successful test, failed test, missing key, and local mode.
Changing provider, endpoint, saving credentials, or deleting credentials invalidates the previous result.
Status labels resolve through EN/VI localization catalogs.
verification: Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow
Static check confirms only provider ID/result are persisted and no duplicate localization keys exist.
recovery: Revert the single task commit if provider settings or status reporting regresses.
